title: Simulated scenario
description: Fully simulated demonstration. The household background load and the appliance traces are generated by documented scripts with fixed seeds; they are not measurements of a real home. In the current week the simulated air conditioner runs longer each day and the simulated water heater draws more power while running.
composition: fully_synthetic: aggregate.csv = synthetic background + sum(synthetic appliance traces); real-model inference is disabled for this bundle.
base_selection_note: No validated 21-day validation/test window from real data is available yet (data audit and split not run), so the mandatory fully synthetic fallback is used (ARCHITECTURE.md §10.2).
